<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Muhammad Mueen — Network Infrastructure & Telecom Specialist</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

:root{
  --bg:#07100E;
  --bg2:#0B1916;
  --panel:#10241F;
  --panel2:#0E1F1B;
  --line:rgba(56,199,213,.16);
  --line-strong:rgba(56,199,213,.32);
  --cyan:#38C7D5;
  --green:#33E08B;
  --amber:#FFB648;
  --white:#EAF6F2;
  --muted:#93ABA6;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.container{width:min(1240px,92%);margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:3}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
h1,h2,h3,.disp{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}
::selection{background:var(--cyan);color:#04120F}

/* ===== ambient grid ===== */
.gridbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(56,199,213,.05) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(56,199,213,.05) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:46px 46px;animation:gridDrift 26s linear infinite;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,black 45%,transparent 92%)}
@keyframes gridDrift{to{background-position:46px 46px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.gridbg{animation:none}}

/* ===== reveal ===== */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}
.reveal.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}}

/* ===== status ticker ===== */
.statusbar{position:relative;z-index:20;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#040a08;overflow:hidden}
.statusTrack{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:tick 24s linear infinite;padding:7px 0;font:11px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted)}
.statusTrack span{margin-right:38px} .statusTrack b{color:var(--green)}
@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ===== nav ===== */
.navbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(7,16,14,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.navrow{height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.brandmark{width:34px;height:34px;border:1.5px solid var(--cyan);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 13px 'Space Grotesk';color:var(--cyan);position:relative}
.brandmark:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:4px;height:4px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;top:-2px;right:-2px;animation:blink 1.6s infinite}
.brandtext{font:700 15px 'Space Grotesk';letter-spacing:.02em}
.brandtext small{display:block;font:10px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:400}
.navlinks{display:none;gap:26px;font:600 12px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)}
.navlinks a:hover{color:var(--cyan)}
.navbtn{border:1px solid var(--line-strong);color:var(--cyan);padding:9px 14px;font:600 11px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.08em}
.navbtn:hover{background:var(--cyan);color:#04120F}
@media(min-width:920px){.navlinks{display:flex}}

/* ===== hero (full-bleed photo background) ===== */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:92vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:120px 0 60px;overflow:hidden}
.heroPhoto{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0}
.heroPhoto img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:68% 30%;filter:contrast(1.04) saturate(.95)}
.heroFadeX{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bg) 0%,rgba(7,16,14,.55) 22%,rgba(7,16,14,.15) 38%,transparent 52%)}
.heroFadeY{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,16,14,.4) 0%,transparent 20%,transparent 78%,var(--bg) 100%)}
@media(max-width:920px){
  .heroPhoto img{object-position:72% 22%}
  .heroFadeX{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,16,14,.15) 0%,rgba(7,16,14,.7) 50%,var(--bg) 86%)}
  .heroFadeY{display:none}
}
.scan{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--cyan),transparent);box-shadow:0 0 22px var(--cyan);animation:scanMove 6s linear infinite;opacity:.45;z-index:1}
@keyframes scanMove{0%{top:0%}100%{top:100%}}
.heroInner{position:relative;z-index:2}
.heroText{max-width:600px}
@media(max-width:920px){.heroText{max-width:100%}}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 12px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--green)}
.eyebrow:before{content:"";width:22px;height:1px;background:var(--green)}
h1.name{font:800 clamp(38px,5.4vw,64px)/1.08;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:16px 0 6px;color:var(--white)}
h1.name .hi{color:var(--green)}
.roleTitle{font:600 17px/1.5 'Space Grotesk';color:var(--cyan)}
.roleStack{font:13px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px}
.roleStack b{color:var(--amber);font-weight:600}
.heroLead{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--muted);max-width:560px;margin-top:16px}
.cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:28px}
.btn{padding:14px 20px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-strong);font:700 12px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.08em;background:rgba(56,199,213,.04);color:var(--white);cursor:pointer}
.btn.primary{background:var(--green);color:#04120F;border-color:var(--green)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--cyan);transition:.2s}

/* ===== hero skill icons ===== */
.heroSkills{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
.hSkill{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;width:64px;text-align:center}
.hSkill .ic{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--cyan);font-size:15px}
.hSkill span{font:9.5px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.3}

/* ===== floating stat card on photo ===== */
.statCard{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;max-width:360px;background:rgba(8,18,16,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);padding:16px 18px;margin-top:28px}
.statCard .k{font:11px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--green);letter-spacing:.1em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.statCard .k:before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;animation:blink 1.4s infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.2}}
.statCard p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#C9DAD6;margin:9px 0 10px}
.statCard svg{display:block;width:100%;height:34px;margin:6px 0}
.statCard .foot{font:10px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.05em}
.statCard .foot b{display:block;color:var(--cyan);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}

/* ===== sections ===== */
section{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:88px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(56,199,213,.08)}
.tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font:700 11px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:12px}
.tag .b{border:1px solid var(--green);padding:2px 7px}
.head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:40px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:44px}
@media(max-width:820px){.head{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
h2{font:700 clamp(32px,4.2vw,50px)/1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;color:var(--white)}
.head p{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--muted);margin:0;max-width:520px}

/* ===== profile ===== */
.profileWrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:50px;align-items:start}
@media(max-width:860px){.profileWrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.profileText p{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.9;color:#C9DAD6;margin:0 0 18px}
.profileText b{color:var(--cyan);font-weight:600}
.miniStat{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);padding:20px}
.miniStat + .miniStat{margin-top:14px}
.miniStat strong{display:block;font:700 32px 'Space Grotesk';color:var(--cyan)}
.miniStat span{font:11px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em}

/* ===== expertise / meters ===== */
.expertGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px}
@media(max-width:760px){.expertGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.expCard{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);padding:22px 24px}
.expTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.expCard h3{font:700 19px 'Space Grotesk';margin:0}
.expCard .pct{font:12px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--amber)}
.expCard p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 14px}
.meter{height:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.meterFill{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--green));transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.expCard.show .meterFill{width:var(--lvl)}

/* ===== journey stepper ===== */
.journey{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.jstep{flex:1;min-width:150px;padding:22px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;background:var(--panel2)}
.jstep:last-child{border-right:none}
.jstep .jn{font:11px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted)}
.jstep h4{font:700 16px 'Space Grotesk';margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--white)}
.jstep.now{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(56,199,213,.12),rgba(51,224,139,.05));border-top:2px solid var(--cyan)}
.jstep.now .jn{color:var(--cyan)}
.jstep.now:after{content:"YOU ARE HERE";position:absolute;top:-11px;left:18px;background:var(--cyan);color:#04120F;font:700 9px 'JetBrains Mono';padding:2px 8px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.jstep.target{background:transparent}
.jstep.target h4{color:var(--amber)}
.jstep.target .jn{color:var(--amber)}
.jarrow{display:none;align-items:center;padding:0 4px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(min-width:760px){.jarrow{display:flex}}

/* ===== currently building ===== */
.buildGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.bItem{background:var(--bg2);padding:18px 20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bItem .t{font:600 14px 'Space Grotesk'}
.pill{font:10px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.06em;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid var(--amber);color:var(--amber);white-space:nowrap}
.pill.dev{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan)}

/* ===== experience ===== */
.jobs{display:grid;gap:16px}
.job{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);padding:28px 30px}
.jobHead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:6px}
.jobDate{font:12px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--green)}
.jobLoc{font:12px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.job h3{font:700 26px 'Space Grotesk';margin:12px 0 2px;color:var(--white)}
.jobRole{font:13px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--cyan)}
.subproj{margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.subproj .pname{font:700 14px 'Space Grotesk';color:var(--amber);margin-bottom:8px}
.job ul{margin:12px 0 0;padding-left:20px;color:#C7D8D4;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8}
.toolTags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:16px}
.toolTags span{font:10px 'JetBrains Mono';border:1px solid var(--line-strong);color:var(--cyan);padding:4px 8px}

/* ===== projects ===== */
.projGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px}
@media(max-width:820px){.projGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.pcard{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);padding:26px}
.pcard .pnum{font:11px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted)}
.pcard h3{font:700 24px 'Space Grotesk';margin:8px 0 14px;color:var(--white)}
.pfield{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:8px;font-size:13.5px;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.pfield:first-of-type{border-top:none}
.pfield .k{font:11px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--amber);letter-spacing:.05em}
.pfield .v{color:#C7D8D4;line-height:1.6}

/* ===== toolkit ===== */
.toolGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
@media(max-width:760px){.toolGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.toolItem{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);padding:20px 12px;text-align:center}
.toolIcon{font-size:24px;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:8px;display:block}
.toolItem .t{font:12px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em}

/* ===== building toward ===== */
.towardGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:center}
@media(max-width:820px){.towardGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.towardCol{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);padding:26px}
.towardCol .k{font:11px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.1em}
.towardCol h3{font:700 21px 'Space Grotesk';margin:10px 0 12px}
.towardCol ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;color:#C7D8D4;font-size:14px;line-height:1.9}
.towardCol.current{border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.towardCol.target{border-color:var(--amber)}
.towardCol.target h3{color:var(--amber)}
.towardArrow{color:var(--cyan);font-size:22px;text-align:center;display:none}
@media(min-width:820px){.towardArrow{display:block}}

/* ===== contact ===== */
.contactWrap{border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--panel2),#081412)}
.contactTop{padding:46px 36px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.contactTop p{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--muted);max-width:600px;margin-top:14px}
.contactGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
@media(max-width:760px){.contactGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.cItem{padding:20px 22px;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.cItem:last-child{border-right:none}
.cItem .k{font:10px 'JetBrains Mono';color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.1em}
.cItem .v{font:700 13.5px 'JetBrains Mono';margin-top:7px;word-break:break-word;color:var(--white)}

footer{padding:28px 0;position:relative;z-index:2}
footer .container{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font:10px 'JetBrains Mono';letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="gridbg"></div>

<div class="statusbar"><div class="statusTrack mono">
<span><b>●</b> SYSTEM ONLINE</span><span>LOCATION: JEDDAH, SAUDI ARABIA</span><span>STATUS: OPEN TO OPPORTUNITIES</span><span>UPTIME: 5+ YEARS FIELD EXPERIENCE</span>
<span><b>●</b> SYSTEM ONLINE</span><span>LOCATION: JEDDAH, SAUDI ARABIA</span><span>STATUS: OPEN TO OPPORTUNITIES</span><span>UPTIME: 5+ YEARS FIELD EXPERIENCE</span>
</div></div>

<nav class="navbar"><div class="container navrow">
  <div class="brand"><div class="brandmark">MM</div><div class="brandtext">MUHAMMAD MUEEN<small>NETWORK &amp; TELECOM SPECIALIST</small></div></div>
  <div class="navlinks">
    <a href="#profile">PROFILE</a>
    <a href="#expertise">EXPERTISE</a>
    <a href="#journey">JOURNEY</a>
    <a href="#experience">EXPERIENCE</a>
    <a href="#projects">PROJECTS</a>
    <a href="#toolkit">TOOLKIT</a>
  </div>
  <a class="navbtn" href="#contact">CONTACT</a>
</div></nav>

<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="heroPhoto"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Muhammad Mueen"></div>
  <div class="heroFadeX"></div>
  <div class="heroFadeY"></div>
  <div class="scan"></div>

  <div class="container heroInner">
    <div class="heroText">
      <div class="eyebrow reveal">NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE &amp; TELECOM SPECIALIST</div>
      <h1 class="name reveal">BUILDING CONNECTIONS.<br>POWERING <span class="hi">INFRASTRUCTURE.</span></h1>
      <p class="heroLead reveal">Hands-on Technical Specialist in Network Infrastructure, Fiber Optics, GPON/FTTx, Structured Cabling, ELV &amp; CCTV Systems.</p>

      <div class="heroSkills reveal">
        <div class="hSkill"><div class="ic">&#9671;</div><span>NETWORKING</span></div>
        <div class="hSkill"><div class="ic">&#9345;</div><span>FIBER OPTICS</span></div>
        <div class="hSkill"><div class="ic">&#9676;</div><span>GPON / FTTx</span></div>
        <div class="hSkill"><div class="ic">&#9638;</div><span>STRUCTURED CABLING</span></div>
        <div class="hSkill"><div class="ic">&#9673;</div><span>CCTV SYSTEMS</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="cta reveal">
        <a class="btn primary" href="#experience">VIEW MY WORK &rarr;</a>
        <a class="btn" href="#contact">GET IN TOUCH</a>
      </div>

      <div class="statCard reveal">
        <div class="k">TECHNICAL SPECIALIST</div>
        <p>5+ years of hands-on infrastructure experience</p>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 200 40" preserveAspectRatio="none">
          <polyline points="0,32 25,28 50,30 75,18 100,22 125,10 150,14 175,6 200,8" fill="none" stroke="#33E08B" stroke-width="2"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="foot">CURRENT FOCUS:<b>CCNA &amp; NETWORK ENGINEERING</b></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="profile">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="tag"><span class="b">01</span>PROFILE</div>
    <div class="head reveal">
      <h2>Field-built.<br>Engineering-directed.</h2>
      <p>Honest read on where I am and where I'm headed — no shortcuts on the title.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="profileWrap">
      <div class="profileText reveal">
        <p>I started with hands-on technical work in <b>telecom, fiber optics, CCTV and infrastructure</b> — first on CCTV and IT infrastructure systems, then moving into fiber optic networks under PTCL's GPON/FTTx expansion in Pakistan.</p>
        <p>Over 5+ years I've developed practical experience in <b>installation, termination, testing, troubleshooting and commissioning</b> — from fusion splicing and OTDR/OPM testing to structured cabling, Fluke DSX certification, IP CCTV and BMS/ELV systems now on live projects in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.</p>
        <p>I'm currently strengthening my networking knowledge and <b>preparing for CCNA</b> — routing, switching, subnetting and troubleshooting — as the next stage toward my goal: becoming a <b>Network Infrastructure Engineer</b>.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="reveal">
        <div class="miniStat"><strong>5+</strong><span class="mono">YEARS HANDS-ON FIELD EXPERIENCE</span></div>
        <div class="miniStat"><strong>500+</strong><span class="mono">FIBER / GPON-FTTx DEPLOYMENTS</span></div>
        <div class="miniStat"><strong>200+</strong><span class="mono">CCTV SYSTEMS COMMISSIONED</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="expertise">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="tag"><span class="b">02</span>TECHNICAL EXPERTISE</div>
    <div class="head reveal">
      <h2>What I've built<br>hands-on.</h2>
      <p>Depth reflects real field time — strongest where I've spent years, developing where I'm actively learning.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="expertGrid">
      <div class="expCard reveal" style="--lvl:92%"><div class="expTop"><h3>Fiber Optics &amp; GPON/FTTx</h3><span class="pct mono">STRONG</span></div><p>Cable pulling, routing, termination, fusion splicing, ONT/ONU provisioning, last-mile deployment.</p><div class="meter"><div class="meterFill"></div></div></div>
      <div class="expCard reveal" style="--lvl:90%"><div class="expTop"><h3>Structured Cabling</h3><span class="pct mono">STRONG</span></div><p>Cat6 cabling, patch panels, ODFs, network racks, labeling, connectivity verification.</p><div class="meter"><div class="meterFill"></div></div></div>
      <div class="expCard reveal" style="--lvl:88%"><div class="expTop"><h3>Testing &amp; Certification</h3><span class="pct mono">STRONG</span></div><p>OTDR, Optical Power Meter, Fluke DSX cable certification, fault diagnosis.</p><div class="meter"><div class="meterFill"></div></div></div>
      <div class="expCard reveal" style="--lvl:82%"><div class="expTop"><h3>IP CCTV &amp; NVR</h3><span class="pct mono">STRONG</span></div><p>IP/analog cameras, NVR/DVR configuration, IP addressing, remote access, network integration.</p><div class="meter"><div class="meterFill"></div></div></div>
      <div class="expCard reveal" style="--lvl:78%"><div class="expTop"><h3>ELV / BMS</h3><span class="pct mono">DEVELOPING</span></div><p>Honeywell &amp; Johnson Controls infrastructure, VAV, FCU, sensors, fire alarm network support.</p><div class="meter"><div class="meterFill"></div></div></div>
      <div class="expCard reveal" style="--lvl:45%"><div class="expTop"><h3>Network Fundamentals</h3><span class="pct mono">LEARNING</span></div><p>Router/ONT/ONU configuration, IP addressing, subnetting, Cisco Packet Tracer — preparing for CCNA.</p><div class="meter"><div class="meterFill"></div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="journey">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="tag"><span class="b">03</span>MY JOURNEY TO NETWORK ENGINEERING</div>
    <div class="head reveal">
      <h2>The direction<br>is the point.</h2>
      <p>A career path in progress, not a finished title — this is the track I'm on.</p>
    </div>
